description: SBrowserX v1.2.4: в байткоде окончательно отключены 4 метода градиентных полос статус-бара и навбара Samsung (enableFade/setFade + API 35 edge-to-edge и блюр-полоса компактной панели), исправлен нативный краш при ручном переключении с тёмной темы на светлую (убран вызов TerraceCommandLine.removeSwitch в рантайме) и добавлена кнопка перезапуска браузера (круговая стрелка) в правый верхний угол всех экранов настроек с подсветкой при любых изменениях.

patches.name: AMOLED Black & Bottom Bar Transparency Toggle
patches.description: True frosted-glass bottom bar & toolbar translucency with adjustable transparency (15-85%), enhanced Chromium compositor blur, and AMOLED pure black (#000000) dark mode surfaces.

patches.name: Auto-close unused tabs: After 1 day
patches.description: Adds a native 'After 1 day' (24h) radio option directly inside Samsung's Auto-close unused tabs settings screen.

patches.name: Block third-party cookies by default
patches.description: Blocks third-party cookies by default across all sites on fresh installs, while allowing users to re-enable them in Settings.

patches.name: Built-in Google Translate engine
patches.description: Unlocks the Translate button in the side popup menu without Galaxy AI/SCS, routes page translation through Google Translate, and adds Chrome-style Translate settings.

patches.name: Change package and app name
patches.description: Changes the package name, custom permissions, provider authorities, internal content:// URIs, UriMatcher rules, and app display name so SBrowserX runs cleanly alongside stock Samsung Internet.

options.description: Custom Android package name for the patched browser.
Custom launcher display name for the patched browser.

patches.name: Disable Update Prompts & Badges
patches.description: Blocks Galaxy Store and Google Play update checks, update banners, and update badges on the patched browser.

patches.name: External downloader support
patches.description: Forwards HTTP/HTTPS file downloads AND context-menu image/video/link downloads to external download managers (1DM, ADM, ABDM, FDM, Seal, etc.) via SBrowserX settings.

patches.name: Remove 99-Tab Limit
patches.description: Lifts Samsung Internet's 99-tab cap to 9999 tabs (configurable toggle in SBrowserX & Useful Features, enabled by default).

patches.name: Remove telemetry, promotions & updates
patches.description: Disables Samsung Analytics, SILog, SMP marketing push, Promotion Engine, Kindred shopping/coupons, and Galaxy Store update checks while preserving site Web Push notifications.

patches.name: SBrowserX Settings, Extensions & Privacy Core
patches.description: Adds SBrowserX settings hub and mirrors all toggles natively in-place across Samsung Internet's settings sections.

patches.name: Unified Dark Mode, True AMOLED Websites & Vivid Images
patches.description: Syncs website dark mode cleanly with browser Dark/Light mode (system or manual), eliminates Samsung NightDim & 50% dim veil, preserves true site colors/icons, and applies pure AMOLED #000000 backgrounds to darkened websites when AMOLED Black is ON.

patches.name: Unlock Chrome Web Store & Extensions
patches.description: Force-enables SIX extensions engine, unlocks extensions WebUI & Chrome Web Store, and prevents SixPkgUpdater from auto-uninstalling sideloaded CRX extensions on restart.

patches.name: Unlock Compact Layout
patches.description: Restores Samsung Internet's native Compact toolbar layout, fixes More-Menu height oscillation and Compact pill scroll/refresh jitter, and replaces the Galaxy AI button with a user-configurable button.

patches.name: Unlock Debug settings menu
patches.description: Always shows Samsung Internet's hidden Debug settings menu inside Settings.
